rules.title: An Act relative to preventing algorithmic rent fixing in the rental housing market (H.5222)
rules.requirement: Proposed bill to prevent algorithmic rent fixing in the rental housing market. The page does not include the bill text, so its specific prohibitions are not stated. On 3/12/2026 the Joint Committee on Housing reported it favorably as a new draft of H1564 and referred it to House Ways and Means. It has not been enacted.
